query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records
            WHERE employee_id = $1
              AND check_in_at >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE $2) AT TIME ZONE $2
              AND check_in_at < (date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE $2) + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE $2
              AND check_out_at IS NULL
        ) AS "exists!"
